crossRefs.note: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him…
In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the…
with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance…
Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…

translations.web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
translations.bsb: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.
translations.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
translations.asv: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.
